mapper.select: SELECT heap_stats_id AS id, count, max_size AS maxSize, size, start_time AS timestamp FROM cj_heap_stats WHERE (start_time >= #{startTime} AND start_time <= #{endTime} AND tid = #{tid})
SELECT used_size AS usedSize, total_size AS totalSize, start_time AS timestamp FROM cj_heap_usage WHERE (start_time >= #{startTime} AND start_time <= #{endTime} AND tid = #{tid})

SELECT seq_num AS id, raw_id AS rawId, start_time AS timestamp, duration, file_size AS fileSize, number_switch AS isFilterNumber FROM cj_heap_dump WHERE (start_time <= #{endTime} AND (start_time + duration) >= #{startTime})
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO cj_heap_stats (tid, heap_stats_id, count, size, max_size, start_time) VALUES
(#{tid}, #{item.id}, #{item.count}, #{item.size}, #{item.maxSize}, #{item.timestamp})

INSERT INTO cj_heap_usage (tid, used_size, total_size, start_time) VALUES
(#{tid}, #{item.usedSize}, #{item.totalSize}, #{item.timestamp})

INSERT INTO cj_heap_dump (seq_num, raw_id, start_time, duration, file_size, number_switch) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.rawId}, #{item.timestamp}, #{item.duration}, #{item.fileSize}, #{item.isFilterNumber})
